commands.actual: MaterializedPackage and PackageManifest are interfaces (no constructors). ApprovedPackage is an interface (no constructors). ActivityApprovedPackage is package-private (`final class`, not `public class`); its sole creation expression is in the Activity's private state machine, and TraceboxDisclosureActivity exposes only private confirmFreshGesture(), with no ApprovalIssuer class or public issue method.

finding_disposition.evidence: The old public ApprovalIssuer and public materialized/manifest constructors were removed. Finalized package, manifest, and approved-package APIs are constructor-free interfaces; the concrete approval implementation is non-public and constructed only after the Activity Confirm button callback.

finding_disposition.finding: Major 1: raw artifacts enter Standard snapshot
finding_disposition.evidence: PackagePipelineTest.raw_artifact_source_has_no_standard_request_constructor_path documents that SegmentSource.records is List<OrdinarySourceRecord>, while RawArtifactSource is a disjoint PackageSourceInput subtype.

finding_disposition.finding: Major 2: final and staged bytes bypass quota
finding_disposition.evidence: PackagePipelineTest.finalized_zip_byte_count_is_charged_not_entry_bodies proves actual ZIP bytes, including overhead, are charged and an exact-byte-short quota fails. ExportWorkflowTest.staging_write_without_exact_quota_reservation_is_rejected proves staging rejects before writing when its reservation transfer fails. StagingLeaseManager atomically transfers that same reservation before Files.write and releases it on TTL cleanup.
Rust now encodes the logical map fixture via encode_canonical_cbor; canonical_cbor_encoder_matches_kotlin_shared_golden_vector compares its emitted bytes to the Kotlin test's [a1,61,61,01] literal.

finding_disposition.finding: Major 4: failed/cancelled receipt can carry handoff
finding_disposition.evidence: ExportReceipt is sealed. GenerationFailed and Cancelled contain no save or handoff fields; only ExportReceipt.Approved carries them. ExportWorkflowTest.failed_pipeline_receipt_has_no_shareable_fields validates the failed variant.

limitations: Validation was host-level only. No Android emulator or AVD was created, booted, or provisioned.
P4.1 remains IN_PROGRESS because the Phase 2/3 recovered-store adapter remains outside this review-fix scope.
